plugins.name: Clock
plugins.readme:
Adds a live clock widget that updates every second.

**Widget:** Shows time (HH:MM:SS) and current date.

**No configuration needed.** Just install and restart.
plugins.author: Deck

plugins.name: System Monitor
plugins.description: CPU, RAM usage and uptime widget
plugins.readme:
Monitors your PC resources in real-time.

**Widget data:**
- CPU usage (%)
- RAM usage (%)
- System uptime
- Hostname

Updates every 3 seconds.
plugins.author: Deck

plugins.name: Spotify
plugins.description: Control Spotify playback and see now playing
plugins.readme:
Control Spotify from your tablet.

**Actions:**
- `spotify:toggle` — Play/Pause
- `spotify:next` — Next track

**Widget:** Shows currently playing song and artist.

**Requirements:** Spotify must be running on your PC. macOS only for now.
plugins.author: Deck

plugins.name: Pomodoro Timer
plugins.description: 25 min focus timer with notification when done
plugins.readme:
Focus timer based on the Pomodoro technique.

**Action:** `pomodoro:toggle` — Start or cancel timer

**Widget:** Shows remaining time (MM:SS) and status (idle/running).

**How it works:**
1. Start a 25-minute timer
2. Get a notification + sound when time is up
3. Take a break!

Plays system sound on macOS when done.
plugins.author: Deck
